Response variable.reasoning: This header names the dependent biological trait being measured: Bumblebee density.

Model.reasoning: Refers to the statistical model used (m.bb1), not an organism or location.

Explanatory variable.reasoning: These are independent variables/factors in a regression model, not traits of the insect.

Estimate.reasoning: This column holds the calculated coefficient or value for each explanatory variable.

Std.Error.reasoning: Represents the standard error of the estimate, a statistical measure of variability.

lower CI.reasoning: This column provides the lower bound of the confidence interval, a statistical range.

upper CI.reasoning: This column provides the upper bound of the confidence interval, a statistical range.

z-value.reasoning: Represents the z-score or test statistic used to assess significance.

P.reasoning: This column holds the p-value, a statistical measure of probability/significance.
